Treasurer Help Guide

Role-specific help for the Treasurer dashboard

Your Role: As treasurer, you manage the organization’s funds by recording monthly dues, processing financial aid, managing reports, and handling other fund transactions.

This guide walks you through these tasks step by step:

  • Monthly Dues Process: record the entries submitted by the President.
  • Aid Request Workflow: input financial aid for eligible members.
  • Report Management & Generation: configure, generate, and submit reports.
  • Membership & Rank Management: manage ranks, member profiles, and new members.
  • Other Fund Transactions: record deposits and withdrawals.
Note: Review, adjust, and record the entries submitted by the President.

Follow these steps to record the monthly dues:

1.
Navigate to Monthly Deductions: Go to the Monthly Dues section on the navigation menu; select Monthly Deductions from the sub-navigation options.
2.
Review & Adjust Entries: Before finalizing the record, customize the entries as needed: check Select All to include all eligible members, uncheck members to Exclude them, adjust Allocations, or modify Amounts for specific members.
3.
Save and Record: Review all modified details to ensure accuracy.
4.
Submit: Click the button for submitting to finalize and record the entries.
Note: Input the aid request; it then moves through verification and approval.

To process financial aid for eligible members, follow these multi-step approval stages:

1.
Treasurer Entry: Input and submit the preliminary aid request details into the system.
2.
Auditor Verification: The Auditor navigates to Audit/Verify Aid Requests to review and verify the request details.
3.
President Approval: The President performs the final review and grants approval.
Note: Generate and submit reports for the Auditor to audit.

Navigation: Reporting Engine > Reports Management

1.
Go to Reports Management.
2.
Choose the appropriate Report Type.
3.
Apply Filters: Department - select All Departments or specific individual departments; Period - choose the specific Month and Year for the report.
4.
Review the generated report contents for accuracy.
5.
Click Submit to forward the report to the Auditor for auditing.
Note: Manage ranks, member profiles, and new registrations via Membership.
1.
Academic Rank Management: Navigation: Membership > Position/Rank
  • Add Rank: Click Add New, fill in the rank details, and save.
  • Edit Rank: Select an existing rank to modify its title or parameters.
  • Remove Rank: Delete outdated or unused academic ranks.
2.
Member List & Profile Editing: Navigation: Membership > Members List
View the complete roster of registered members and update member information as necessary.
3.
Adding New Members: Navigation: Membership > Create Member
  • Open the Create Member page.
  • Input all required member information.
  • Click Submit to register the new member.
Note: Log deposits and withdrawals with supporting proof receipts.

Navigation: ISUCauFA Fund > Other Transactions

1.
Navigate to Other Transactions.
2.
Select the transaction type: Deposit or Withdrawal.
3.
Input the transaction Amount.
4.
Upload the supporting Proof Receipt image or document.
5.
Click Submit to record the transaction.
